name: React
summary: The UI runtime every component layer here assumes: the 109 AI components, the shadcn-style records, and the dashboards all emit React TSX.

steps: Real project: scaffold with Vite (npm create vite@latest my-app -- --template react-ts), then npm install react react-dom (already in the template).

Single-file prototype: import React and createRoot from the esm.sh URLs in install.cdn inside a <script type="module"> tag. React 19 dropped UMD builds, so esm.sh ESM imports are the CDN path that works.
When the user wants styled components on top, follow the tailwind entry, then the shadcn entry.

files.content:
import { createRoot } from "react-dom/client"
import App from "./App.jsx"
import "./index.css"

createRoot(document.getElementById("root")).render(<App />)

files.role: CDN-only React page with no build step, for quick prototypes the user can open directly

notes: The esm.sh CDN path is for prototypes the user asked for, not for this repo: the gallery itself never references a CDN. For real projects prefer the Vite scaffold, which pins react, react-dom, and the TypeScript types (@types/react, @types/react-dom). When the gallery is running, the same modules are served from it: call design_asset_importmap (or fetch /assets/importmap.json) and embed the map, then `import { useState } from "react"` loads from the local server with zero network. Modules are content-addressed and CORS-enabled.
